name: 兩張並排圖片卡片（左下標題、右下箭頭圖示按鈕）
desc: 兩張等寬等高的橫式圖片卡片左右並排，每張左下疊標題、右下疊圓形箭頭圖示按鈕；手機改為直向堆疊，按鈕跨出卡片右緣。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊沒有獨立的標題組，由兩個等寬、等高的項目左右並排組成，每列兩個大項目，各佔頁面內容寬度約一半，對齊頁面內容寬度。每個項目是一張卡片，整面是一張橫式圖片，圖片貼齊卡片四邊，兩張圖片同一比例；卡片上半部只有圖片，文字集中在下緣：左下方疊一個標題（可多行），右下方疊一個圓形圖示按鈕，標題和按鈕的底部對齊在同一高度。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，每列一個項目，依原本左右順序上下排列；卡片內標題仍在左下、圖示按鈕仍在右下，但圖示按鈕跨出卡片右緣一部分，和卡片邊緣重疊。

en.name: Two side-by-side image cards (title bottom-left, arrow icon button bottom-right)
en.desc: Two equal-width, equal-height landscape image cards side by side, each with a title overlaid at the bottom-left and a round arrow icon button at the bottom-right; on mobile they stack vertically and the button sticks out past the card's right edge.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section has no separate heading group and consists of two equal-width, equal-height items placed side by side, two large items per row, each taking about half of the page content width, aligned to the page content width. Each item is a card filled entirely by one landscape image, flush with all four edges of the card, and both images share the same aspect ratio; the upper part of the card holds only the image, and the text is concentrated along the bottom edge: a title (may wrap to multiple lines) is overlaid at the bottom-left, and a round icon button is overlaid at the bottom-right, with the bottoms of the title and the button aligned at the same height.
en.mobile: Stack vertically, one item per row, in the original left-to-right order from top to bottom; inside each card the title stays at the bottom-left and the icon button at the bottom-right, but the icon button sticks out past the card's right edge, overlapping the card edge.
